subject: SIG Questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up from discovery call)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG Questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up from discovery call)

Hi John / Acme security team,

Thanks again for the time on today's discovery call - good to meet you. As discussed, we'll kick off the vendor security questionnaire (SIG Lite) and want to capture a few clarifying items up front so we scope answers correctly. Attached is our standard SIG template and a short security factsheet for reference.

Quick recap from our side: Redwood Inference is a developer-first inference platform for serving LLMs. Our hosted offering will be in-scope for this engagement (we discussed dedicated/private options in later phases).

Clarifying questions to help us complete the SIG accurately:
- Scope: should we complete answers for Production only, or include Staging/Dev as well?
- Regulatory classification: you mentioned potential PHI - can you confirm if AcmeHealth wants us to operate under a BAA and handle PHI/HIPAA controls?
- Data residency: any required regions / EU data flow constraints?
- Retention: target retention window for logs/alerts/LLM inputs/outputs you expect from us?
- Encryption: any special KMS/bring-your-own-key (BYOK) requirements?
- Subprocessors: we will list subprocessors; do you require a pre-approved list or security snapshots for each?
- Pen test / 3rd-party attestations: do you require annual pen test reports and/or a SOC 2 Type II report?

Proposed next steps:
1) If you confirm scope above, we'll fill the SIG template and return a first-pass within 3 business days.
2) Nikhil (cc'd) will own the technical answers and can hop on a short call if you want to walk through PHI flows.
3) Camila (cc'd) will coordinate contract/legal items (BAA, DPA) if needed.

Please let us know the preferred format for the completed questionnaire (spreadsheet vs. secure portal) and any additional contacts we should include.

Attachments: SIG_template.xlsx, redwood_security_factsheet.pdf

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.green@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up from discovery call)

Marissa - thanks for the follow-up and the attachments. A few quick answers to your clarifying questions to help you scope the SIG: 
- Scope: Production only for now. We will evaluate non-prod later.
- PHI/HIPAA: we do process PHI in this workflow and will require a signed BAA before production go-live.
- Data residency: US-only for this project. No EU data flows.
- Retention: we require logs/alerts retained for 1 year; LLM input/output retention negotiable but default to 30 days unless otherwise agreed.
- Encryption: at-rest + in-transit AES-256; we have an internal KMS and would prefer BYOK if supported.
- Subprocessors: please provide your subprocessors list; we will need to vet.
- Attestations: SOC 2 Type II report is required before procurement; pen test summary is helpful (redacted is fine).

I've attached our high-level security requirements doc for reference (acme_security_requirements.pdf). Preferred format: spreadsheet (SIG template) is fine.

If Nikhil wants to review PHI flows, Alyssa and I can set aside 30 minutes this week.

Thanks,
John
Director, Information Security
AcmeHealth
john.doe@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <john.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG Questionnaire initiation - AcmeHealth (follow-up from discovery call)

John - really appreciate the quick answers and the requirements doc. A few notes against your points:
- Scope: noted - we'll scope for Production only.
- BAA: we can sign a BAA; Camila will loop in Legal and send Redwood's standard BAA for review.
- SOC 2 / pen test: we are currently finalizing our SOC 2 Type II audit (expected completion Q3 2026). We can provide interim SOC 2 Type I artifacts and our security factsheet (attached). Nikhil will start filling the SIG and can include references to the upcoming Type II report. We can also provide a redacted pen test summary - I'll flag that to security.
- BYOK: we support BYOK for Dedicated/Private deployments; for hosted we have KMS options - Nikhil can outline exact options in the SIG answers.
- Retention: we'll mark log retention at 1 year by default and note LLM payload retention as configurable (default 30 days) with options for longer retention on Dedicated.

Next steps:
- Nikhil will begin populating the SIG template and will reach out to Alyssa for a short call to walk through PHI flows.
- Camila will engage Legal for the BAA and send the draft.
- We'll return the completed SIG spreadsheet and supporting artifacts by EOD Wednesday (3 business days).

Attachments: redwood_security_factsheet.pdf

Best,
Marissa
